python_requests_session_init.tooltip: Create a Requests Session for connection pooling, persistent cookies, and shared settings.

python_requests_session_defaults.message0: Requests session %1 set defaults headers %2 query params %3 cookies %4 auth %5 proxies %6 TLS verify %7 client certificate %8 trust environment %9
python_requests_session_defaults.tooltip: Set connected values as Session defaults. Unconnected inputs leave the corresponding setting unchanged.

python_requests_session_close.tooltip: Close the Session and release its connection pools.

python_requests_request.message0: Requests client %1 send %2 to URL %3 options %4
python_requests_request.tooltip: Send any HTTP method. Leave client empty for the module-level API, or connect a Session value.

python_requests_get.message0: Requests client %1 GET URL %2 query params %3 options %4
python_requests_get.tooltip: Send a GET request with optional query parameters and options. Leave client empty for the module-level API.

python_requests_send_body.message0: Requests client %1 send %2 to URL %3 body type %4 body %5 options %6
python_requests_send_body.tooltip: Send a request whose body is JSON, form/raw data, or a Requests files mapping. Explicit body data overrides the same key in options.

python_requests_content_options.message0: content options query params %1 headers %2 cookies %3 auth %4 body type %5 body %6
python_requests_content_options.tooltip: Build request content options. Only connected inputs are included, and at most one body key is generated.

python_requests_network_options.message0: network options timeout %1 proxies %2 follow redirects %3 stream response %4
python_requests_network_options.tooltip: Build timeout, proxy, redirect, and streaming options. Default leaves Requests behavior unchanged.

python_requests_tls_options.message0: TLS options verification %1 CA bundle %2 client certificate %3 private key %4
python_requests_tls_options.tooltip: Build TLS verification and optional client-certificate options. Disabling verification is unsafe and intended only for controlled testing.

python_requests_merge_options.tooltip: Merge two option mappings. Values on the right take precedence.

python_requests_auth.tooltip: Create Basic or Digest authentication credentials. Use HTTPS to protect credentials in transit.

python_requests_timeout.tooltip: Create separate connect and read inactivity timeouts. This is not a total request deadline.

python_requests_proxies.tooltip: Build an HTTP and HTTPS proxy mapping. Unconnected schemes are omitted.

python_requests_upload_file.message0: upload file and set response %1 client %2 method %3 URL %4 form field %5 path %6 filename %7 MIME type %8 options %9
python_requests_upload_file.tooltip: Upload one file using multipart/form-data, assign the Response, and always close the local file handle.

python_requests_response_property.tooltip: Read a Response property. Text is decoded text; content is bytes; OK is true for status codes below 400.

python_requests_response_json.tooltip: Decode the response body as JSON. This may fail independently of the HTTP status.

python_requests_response_lookup.tooltip: Look up a response header or cookie and return a default when it is absent.

python_requests_response_set_encoding.tooltip: Override the encoding used by response.text. Set it before reading text.

python_requests_raise_for_status.message0: response %1 raise for HTTP error status
python_requests_raise_for_status.tooltip: Raise HTTPError for unsuccessful HTTP status codes.

python_requests_try.message0: try Requests operation %1 %2 catch %3 as %4 %5 %6 finally %7 %8
python_requests_try.tooltip: Run request code, catch one Requests exception family, and always run the finally branch.

python_requests_for_chunks.message0: for each chunk %1 in response %2 chunk size %3 decode Unicode %4 do %5 %6
python_requests_for_chunks.tooltip: Iterate non-empty response chunks and close the response afterward. The request should use stream mode.

python_requests_download.message0: download client %1 URL %2 to path %3 options %4 chunk size %5 raise for status %6
python_requests_download.tooltip: Stream a URL to a local file in chunks, close all resources, and optionally reject HTTP error statuses.
